portalsFound.observation: Official Instituto Geografico e Cadastral de Angola site (HTTP 200). Homepage lists surveys, map sales and a land-rights concession window, with no geoportal, service endpoint or open data link and no licence text.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: unstated; layer extent covers roughly Luanda province east to about 19 degrees E, and attributes name Provincia/Municipio/Comuna

remainingUncertainty: The publisher is not shown to be an Angolan government body, and no licence or terms were visible. Polygons look like property records but may be tax-registry capture rather than surveyed cadastre; the layer advertises edit capabilities (not tested) and exposes potentially personal attributes. Completeness, currency and stability of the URL are unknown. An anonymous third-party hosted layer must not be treated as an official open cadastre.
nextStep: Identify the layer's publisher (AGT or another agency) and its terms, look for an official IGCA or AGT service, and only then decide whether the endpoint may be registered for runtime use.
